# Extract the values for education expenditure and GDP for each country group

gdp_row = df[df['Series Name'] == 'GNI per capita (constant 2015 USdollar)']

# Extract the values for these rows
education_expenditure_values = education_expenditure_row.iloc[:, 4:].values
gdp_values = gdp_row.iloc[:, 4:].values

# Calculate the correlation coefficient for each country group
correlation_sub_saharan = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure_values[0], gdp_values[0])[0, 1]
correlation_lower_middle_income = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure_values[1], gdp_values[1])[0, 1]
